caseStudies.title: Panetti Analytics
caseStudies.summary: An in-house replacement for a paid SaaS (BeProfit) that consolidates 8 WooCommerce stores across 5 currencies into one true-profit dashboard, plus a self-service portal for brand ambassadors to track their own sales and commission.
caseStudies.highlight: Fully test-driven and typed end to end, with hourly cron sync and encrypted store credentials. Live in production with 24,000+ real orders.

images.alt: Panetti Analytics admin dashboard showing consolidated true-profit metrics across stores
Panetti Analytics multi-store view unifying four of the eight WooCommerce shops

caseStudies.title: Underwriting Engine
caseStudies.summary: The automated quality-assurance and regression layer for an AI-mediated deal-intake system on a UK residential property underwriting platform. An LLM agent reads and drafts; a deterministic validator, never the model, owns every “ready for analysis” and “send” decision.
caseStudies.highlight: During a sprint sync, the matrix caught a live production regression silently merging multi-property alerts into one deal. I traced it to the exact commit with git bisect, showed the safety guard was correct but never reached, and filed a verified fix path, without touching any valuation logic.

images.alt: Underwriting Engine QA matrix output showing routing, validation state, and safety-rule assertions
